title: Learning Quality-Controllable Robot Policies with Iterative Hindsight Relabeling
abstract: arXiv:2610.37393v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robot policy evaluation often relies on a binary success signal for task completion. In real-world deployment, however, desired execution behaviors are also defined by quality attributes such as execution speed and motion smoothness, which need to be dynamically controlled according to task requirements. To address this, we introduce Quality-Controllable Policy (QCP), a robot policy that enables inference-time control over both individual quality attributes and their combinations. To extend the controllable quality range beyond initial demonstrations, we further propose an iterative hindsight relabeling loop: QCP collects online rollouts under target quality labels, adds successful trajectories to the dataset, relabels the accumulated trajectories in hindsight according to their measured quality, and fine-tunes the policy. translated_title: 基于迭代事后重标注学习质量可控的机器人策略
translated_abstract: 机器人策略评估通常依赖于任务完成的二元成功信号。然而，在实际部署中，期望的执行行为还由执行速度和运动平滑度等质量属性来定义，这些属性需要根据任务要求进行动态控制。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了质量可控策略，这是一种能够在推理时对单个质量属性及其组合进行控制的机器人策略。为了将可控质量范围扩展到初始演示数据之外，我们进一步提出了一种迭代的事后重标注循环：QCP在目标质量标签下收集在线轨迹，将成功的轨迹添加到数据集中，根据测量到的质量对累积的轨迹进行事后重标注，并对策略进行微调。在 Robomimic 和 RoboEval 上的实验表明，QCP 能够持续提升任务执行质量和……
tldr: 提出质量可控策略（QCP），使机器人策略能够在推理时动态控制执行速度、运动平滑度等质量属性及其组合，并通过迭代事后重标注循环将可控质量范围扩展到初始演示数据之外。
en_tdlr: Proposes Quality-Controllable Policy (QCP), enabling inference-time control over quality attributes such as execution speed and motion smoothness, and extends the controllable quality range beyond initial demonstrations through an iterative hindsight relabeling loop.
